properties.notes: Since 2018 Brownfield Land Register, a new permission has been approved: • Planning application 147/01534/F allowed at appeal 2018-11-01 for the demolition of part of the existing extension to allow for the construction of 9 flats. • Planning permission 19/00715/F approved 2019-10-04 for the demolition of part of the existing extension and standalone shed to allow construction of 6 flats.. Proposed demolition of the existing two storey rear extension and stand alone shed to allow construction of a four storey block of 6 no. 2 bed flats to the rear of 4-10 Church Street with new access staircase, car parking, refuse and cycling stores in addition to other alterations including improvements to the rear elevation of the existing building.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
